verdict: G6 is not closable on the SOS-certified witness family at one loop with tree-level matching, with the stated approximations. Exact tree-level matching of the Delta_R = (10bar,1,3) EFT at mu = M_GUT gives lambda4 - lambda5 = (w_4125 - w_2772)/8 + 3 beta_(15,1,1) + 3 beta_(15,1,3) >= 0 on every SOS-safe weight vector (and exactly 1/128 at the witness, whose tree levels 1/96, 17/288, 37/576, 353/3360 and 1/2 reproduce the G6 certificate), while the RG-improved one-loop-positive remnant region needs lambda4 - lambda5 < 0 at M_GUT (-0.416 at rho = 1e3 for its best point, whose FJ pole masses are recomputed here and xi independent to <= 1e-12; the region itself is a sampled, box-bounded research scan, so its lambda4 - lambda5 < 0 is a sampling statement, not a proof over all couplings). The certified witness runs tachyonic: lambda5 crosses zero at 4.68e16 GeV (rho = 1e3). Only the tree-matching statement is robust: the only computed one-loop M_GUT threshold (at the witness, assumed weight independent, not verified) shifts lambda4 - lambda5 by -0.57 (gX = g), which removes the lambda4 >= lambda5 obstruction; the remaining separation is 0.042 at rho = 1e3 and closes at 1.20 to 1.73 times that threshold (and is smaller at rho = 1e4 and without spectators with the alpha^-1 = 23.78 threshold). G6 stays OPEN; the G6 tree certificate is scoped to tree level at mu = M_GUT; G3 and G4 are unchanged; G6 is not shown impossible in the contract (an anti-SOS G3 witness might exist); closing G6 would need controlled weight-dependent M_GUT thresholds and two-loop quartic running and, unless those thresholds open an SOS-safe route, an anti-SOS G3 witness.
